01

“his wealth and what he earned”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 111:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
his wealth and what he earned [al-Masad: 2], meaning: “his child.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ [المسد: 2] ، يَعْنِي: «وَلَدَهُ»

02

“and his wife, the carrier of firewood”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 111:4).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and his wife, the carrier of firewood [al-Masad: 4], he said: “meaning the carrier of slander; she goes about spreading slander.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَالَةَ الْحَطَبِ [المسد: 4] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي حَمَالَةَ النَّمِيمَةِ، تَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ»
